scope: Publicly documented GitHub Copilot metadata and data-category schema
interaction_and_usage: usage metrics and limits where applicable
important_distinctions: Publicly documented metadata categories are not equivalent to access to GitHub's private backend telemetry.
Repository/code context may be processed as part of a Copilot interaction without making that context publicly available.
Availability and retention can depend on product, plan, organization policy, feature, and current GitHub documentation.
collection_rules: Use official GitHub/Copilot privacy, product, API, and enterprise documentation
Record exact source and date for every field/category
Separate public documentation from inferred implementation details
Do not collect private prompts, private repository contents, credentials, or private telemetry without authorization
status: Public documentation metadata schema uploaded for defensive/research cataloging.
